segments.text: You automate everyone else's work. So why is yours scattered across tabs, chats, and forgotten workflow exports?
Meet Automation Context Mapping. A workspace and Control Center built for n8n automation specialists.
Keep client briefs, project rules, and decisions together. Give your AI assistant the context to get started.
Connect multiple n8n instances. See execution trends, investigate failures, and flag workflows that haven't succeeded when expected.
Spot changes in n8n. Schedule workflow exports. Track project versions. Review a restore before sending it back.
From the first client brief to the final handover, keep your automation work connected. Automation Context Mapping. Build with context. Deliver with confidence.
